SURE FOOT Equine Stability Program® | Horse Balance, Relaxation & Performance

The SURE FOOT Equine Stability Program® helps horses improve balance, relaxation, proprioception, and performance using SURE FOOT Pads.

On this channel, you’ll learn how to support your horse’s posture, movement, confidence, and long-term soundness—whether for training, rehabilitation, or everyday handling.

SURE FOOT Pads give horses the opportunity to explore their own balance. As they become more aware of how they are organized over their feet, many horses show reduced tension, improved movement, and greater comfort.

Wendy Murdoch, creator of SURE FOOT, shares how to:

Introduce pads safely
Choose the right pad types
Read your horse’s responses
Improve balance and body awareness
Support rehab, performance, and behavior

Used by horse owners, trainers, veterinarians, bodyworkers, and farriers, SURE FOOT helps horses become more relaxed, balanced, and confident.
